name: book_the_slot_my_expired_hold_was
use_case: Book an appointment by service, staff, language, location and time zone
branch: Book the slot my expired hold was on: CU10 Jack Turner asks the desk to 'book the haircut with Lucia I was holding for Wednesday at 11 am'. His hold H001 (Lucia, 28 October 15:00 UTC) expired at 08:00 today.
tests: the desk explains the hold expired, checks availability, and books 11:00 am with Lucia upon confirmation
instruction:
You want to book the haircut appointment with Lucia Fernandez at Midtown that you previously held for Wednesday 28 October at 11:00 am (2026-10-28T11:00). When the desk explains that your hold expired at 4:00 am New York time today (08:00 UTC), verify if the 11:00 am slot is still available. When the desk confirms it is free and reads back Wednesday 28 October at 11:00 am New York time (UTC-04:00), confirm the booking.

Your details:
- Name: Jack Turner
- Email: jack.turner@example.com
- Phone: +1 212 555 0110
- Service: Haircut
- Staff: Lucia Fernandez
- Studio: Midtown Studio (New York)
- Date: Wednesday 28 October 2026
- Requested time: 11:00 am (2026-10-28T11:00)

persona.name: Jack Turner
persona.initial_message: Hi, I had a hold on a haircut with Lucia for Wednesday at 11 am. Could you please go ahead and book that for me? My email is jack.turner@example.com and phone is +1 212 555 0110.
